landing.hero_desc: HeyGeo is a platform for sharing 2D & 3D dynamic math models.
landing.newest_desc: Models recently shared by the community.
landing.popular_desc: Models most loved and viewed by the community.
landing.gallery_cta_desc: Discover the full collection of math models shared by the community

features.viz_desc: Dynamic math representations are displayed with rigorous mathematical relationships. You can interact with math objects directly in the browser.
features.share_desc: Every HeyGeo, Sketchpad, Web Sketchpad, or GeoGebra model has its own share link. You can add a description and exploration instructions to help viewers understand the model.
features.integrate_desc: Design your model in HeyGeo Desktop, then publish directly to heygeo.pedu.vn via File → Export to Web. You can also upload models created in other dynamic geometry apps.
features.manage_desc: A personal dashboard for each user. Manage all your models, control public/private settings, and upload or edit models with ease.
features.security_desc: Robust security technologies. Publish models to the web via an authenticated API, ensuring only you can manage your models.
features.stats_desc: Track the view count of your publicly shared models. Know which models the community finds most interesting.

steps.step1_desc: Register a new account with your email. Quick and easy.
steps.step2_desc: Design in HeyGeo Desktop or directly on the web via <webCoding>HeyGeo Web Coding</webCoding> or <webDesign>HeyGeo Web Design</webDesign>. Create as many models as you like. You can also upload files from Sketchpad, Web Sketchpad, or GeoGebra.
steps.step3_desc: Enable public mode, add a description and exploration notes, then share the link with students and colleagues.

settings.title: Settings

password.title: Change Password
password.desc: The new password needs at least 8 characters, and you type it once more to confirm.
password.hint: At least 8 characters; combine letters and numbers.
password.too_short: The new password must have at least 8 characters
password.mismatch: The repeated password does not match

sync.title: Browser Sync
sync.desc: Keep a copy of your models inside this browser, and send it back to the server when needed.
sync.explain: The browser copy keeps your models available on the machine you are using: review the list and the data without opening the Dashboard or waiting for the server.
sync.explain_scope: Every browser on every machine has its own set of copies. Clearing browsing data or switching computers loses that set; models on the server stay untouched.
sync.sync_all_done: Synced {{moved}} models; {{held}} still need you to pick a direction.
sync.delete_all_confirm: Delete every copy stored in this browser? Models on the server are kept.
sync.empty: No models yet. Save a model from the Dashboard first.
sync.error_load: Could not load the model list

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.desc: Download a zip file holding all of your models, or restore from a zip you saved earlier.
backup.explain: The zip contains each model's data (models/<id>.json) plus its details: title, description, guide, thumbnail, categories and public status.
backup.explain_restore: Restoring always creates new models - it never overwrites or deletes anything. Restoring twice will show duplicated titles in the Dashboard.
backup.export_desc: The server sends all models, the browser packs them into a zip.
backup.import_desc: Pick a heygeo-backup-*.zip file you downloaded before.
backup.pending_warning: Each model will be re-created as a new copy in your Dashboard.
backup.error_read: This zip file could not be read
backup.error_not_heygeo: This is not a HeyGeo backup file
backup.error_empty: The file contains no readable models
